digest: Computer-chip stocks split the models over the coming week: Amazon Nova says buy strongly and Nemotron + Mercury would buy on price drops, while Qwen and DeepSeek say sell.
Meta AI, Kimi, Gemini and Z.ai would trim those chip stocks, while ChatGPT, Claude, Step, MiMo and Grok would simply hold them.
On the US ten-year interest rate over the week, Amazon Nova, Meta AI and Kimi bet strongly that it rises, while Claude, Nemotron + Mercury, Gemini, MiMo and Z.ai bet that it falls.
The most surprising call is Kimi's strong buy on both kinds of oil, WTI and Brent, for the next day and the week, standing alone in that bold view while most simply hold.
All agree on not betting that the VIX, the market's fear gauge, rises over the next day: Step and Meta AI hold, and the others bet that it falls.
